coverage: 24 independent adversarial API cases and 16 native-packet edit cases per configuration; five source profiles, eight distinct retained packets, ASCII and binary transport.
Bit-exact no-op preserves loaded Payload and Cells snapshots without handle allocation. Explicit signed-zero changes are retained and repeated exact requests are no-ops.
Immutable constructor and caller collection snapshots; negative finite scalar values, raw integer extremes, duplicate cell values and row/column values without inferred row-times-column constraints.
Explicit registered STYLE identity dependencies update removal guards and release old targets; old References snapshots remain unchanged. Foreign and detached identities reject.

MoveNext and Dispose exceptions, caught recursive edits, disposal removal of a requested target, missing source anchor and changed source profile reject without packet or seed mutation. Caller document side effects are not rolled back.
Native no-op and replacement preserve identity, seed and prior snapshots; the explicit replacement packet and untouched companion TABLEGEOMETRY packets reload exactly.
All 52 output drawings audited with ezdxf 1.4.4: no errors or repairs. No native CAD runtime was available or claimed.
fixture_scope: Manifest-pinned whole unchanged originals for R2013 and R2018; previously disclosed selected native packet carriers for R2004, R2007 and R2010.
Group 999 comments are excluded during raw transport conversion because binary DXF has no comment support; no stored TABLEGEOMETRY body changes precede the explicit API request.
